end.parentNote: Asha practised how litter, plastic, noise, feeding animals, and touching or damaging special places can cause harm. Tara explained that plastic can make a beach dirty and hurt fish and turtles, and connected scratching carvings with loss of historical records. Tara also shared giving food to a monkey; next time, practise remembering that visitors should not feed wild animals, even when they seem hungry. At home, ask Tara to name three ways to protect a beach or old monument.
